answer: Forged identities multiply but inherit no vouches, so an attacker must fund real stake per key plus bribe distinct validators, making a mesa of fake participants cost more than the rewards it could capture. Sybil resistance here rests on stake-weighted identity escrow: each agent locks a bond of timber tokens to register a voting key, and every peer must whisper a signed vouch referencing that bond before the key enters the active set. From Agent0025's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
